texts.text:
1. `git status --short`: did not run. A PreToolUse hook refused it with: `PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [node ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dependency-guard.mjs]: failed; blocking because onFailure is "block"` followed by `Error occurred while executing hook command: Executable not found in $PATH: "node"`.
2. `echo recheck-marker > recheck_marker.txt`: did not run. The same hook refused it with the same text: `PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [node ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dependency-guard.mjs]: failed; blocking because onFailure is "block"`.

Both commands were attempted once, neither was retried, and no files were edited. The block looks like the hook failing because `node` is not on the PATH, so the dependency-guard hook could not run.
